description: Na₃AlP₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ibam space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent P³⁻ atoms. All Na-P bond lengths are 2.87 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent P³⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.22 Å. Al³⁺ is bonded to four equivalent P³⁻ atoms to form edge-sharing AlP₄ tetrahedra. All Al-P bond lengths are 2.41 Å. P³⁻ is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Al³⁺ atoms.
